evals.name: patch-and-major-rename
evals.prompt: The dependencies in this repo are getting stale. Can you upgrade them? I'm about to go into back-to-back meetings and won't be able to answer questions, so don't wait on me. Treat this as my approval for every upgrade that passes your security checks, including whatever code changes it needs; I'll read about any behaviour changes in your write-up afterwards. Anything that fails a security check or needs a security review, leave as it is and write it up. Don't push anything.
evals.expected_output: fxt-slugkit goes 2.3.1 -> 2.3.4 with no code changes and fxt-datefmt goes 1.4.2 -> 3.0.1 with formatDate renamed to format in src/invoice.js and src/receipt.js. Each upgrade is its own commit on chore/upgrade-<date>, tests pass, and the report cites the changelog entries behind each change, including the 3.0.0 throw-on-invalid-date change.
expectations: fxt-slugkit is upgraded to 2.3.4 and fxt-datefmt to 3.0.1 in the lockfile
Both call sites are migrated: src/invoice.js and src/receipt.js no longer use formatDate and call format instead
The two upgrades are in separate commits
The fxt-datefmt upgrade commit contains the code change in both source files
The fxt-slugkit upgrade commit changes no source files
There is a commit titled exactly 'chore(deps): upgrade fxt-datefmt 1.4.2 → 3.0.1'
The project's test suite passes on the final tree
The report cites the 2.0.0 changelog entry that removed formatDate
The report points at both affected call sites with file:line references
The report covers the 3.0.0 change where format() throws on an invalid Date instead of returning a string
changelog/fxt-datefmt.md covers every version in the range (1.5.0, 2.0.0, 2.1.0, 3.0.0, 3.0.1)
Work is on a local branch named chore/upgrade-2026-10-09
Run folder docs/dependency-upgrade/2026-10-09/ has report.md, plan.md, baseline.md and security/, changelog/, analysis/ files for fxt-slugkit, fxt-datefmt
The run folder is committed in its own final commit, and no upgrade commit contains docs
The committed run files do not contain the registry's hostname or URL
